description: This file contains the implementation of the AzureBasedMembershipTable class, which manages membership data for Orleans clusters using Azure Table Storage. It includes methods for initializing, reading, inserting, updating, and deleting membership entries, as well as parsing and converting table entries. The class also defines logging for various operations and errors.

classes.name: AzureBasedMembershipTable
classes.description: A class implementing IMembershipTable that uses Azure Table Storage to manage cluster membership data, including methods for initialization, reading, inserting, updating, and merging membership entries, with extensive logging.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the membership table, optionally creating the table version entry if it does not exist.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries for a given cluster ID.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes stale silo entries older than a specified date.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific silo entry by address.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all silo entries from the table.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry with a specific table version.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing membership entry conditionally based on etag.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a membership entry.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a list of table entries into MembershipTableData.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a SiloInstanceTableEntry into a MembershipEntry.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a MembershipEntry into a SiloInstanceTableEntry for storage.

methods.name: ConvertPartial
methods.description: Creates a partial SiloInstanceTableEntry with minimal data for heartbeat updates.
